resource_profile.relation_to_v32: no resource ceilings change from v32
resource_profile.all_other_limits: identical to BoundedV1, including reads, dependency_requests, source_bytes, raw_bytes, models, spool, inventory, stage, package, list_profile and memory

fixtures.budget_note: The seven 1048576-byte values are synthetic parser fixtures only; they are not real acceptance budgets, measured storage requirements, or budgets certified for real extraction.

plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF
plan.partial_encrypted_sections: declared-skip; mandatory in the PLAN only, immediately between decryption and collision-storage
plan.requested_map: absent; no requested_map or substitute field is admitted
plan.requested_map_zero: rejected; zero is not an all-map sentinel

package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-table partial-section declarations only
package.partial_encrypted_tables: Only per-table Map declarations are admitted, bound to dbc/<locale>/Map.db2; a complete table has no declaration.
package.partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden in the package manifest; the same-named PLAN gate remains mandatory
package.global_partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden; no global or package-wide declaration is admitted
package.present_empty_maps: A present active map with no placements retains its tree and empty proof; it is distinct from WDT or vacated-WMO omission.
package.root_absent_maps: Every WDT ROOT-absent active map remains in Coverage.maps without tree, proof, tile or model artifacts.
package.vacated_wmo: A WMO FileDataId may be declared only after a local WMO doodad M2 ROOT-absence omission, no geometry output, no remaining binding, MODR participation in selection and empty selection references after omission. No VMO, binding, valid name, spawn, placement or model ID is emitted for it.
package.present_wmo_with_missing_doodad: Retain the present parent WMO and each present doodad, including VMO, binding, valid name, spawn and placement; omit only the declared absent M2 child.

coverage_codec.maps: the complete active domain, including Present and WDT RootAbsent entries; maps=wdt_files+root_absent
coverage_codec.missing_m2: canonical ordered unique nonzero WMO doodad M2 FileDataIds after Coverage.maps; direct ADT M2 IDs are never included
coverage_codec.missing_wmo: canonical ordered unique nonzero vacated WMO FileDataIds after resource_profile and before artifacts; disjoint from missing_m2
coverage_codec.vacated_wmo_admission: WMO FileDataId origin; at least one local guarded ROOT-absent M2 doodad omission; no geometry output; no remaining bindings; MODR participated in selection; selection references empty after omission

strict_wrappers.foreign_or_mixed_masks: rejected by each profile-specific verify and verify-links wrapper before coverage acceptance
strict_wrappers.shared_mask17: sharing mask 17 does not permit crossing layout version, resource profile, WDT/M2/WMO policy, missing_m2/missing_wmo lists, coverage path, source or coverage profile, domain closure, selection or publication profile
strict_wrappers.zero_selection_aliases: requested_map=0 and MapSelection::MapAndAncestors(0) are rejected and never treated as MapSelection::All

coverage_codec.binding: The v33 coverage and package contexts must match the canonical PLAN, including RCVGEO1 v6, RequestHeavyV1, all three omission policies, canonical missing_m2/missing_wmo, MapSelection::All and mask 17. v32 remains RCVGEO1 v5 with RequestHeavyV1; zero omissions do not change either version.

source_policy.resource_profile: RequestHeavyV1 changes only collector.max_requests and startup_limits().collision.max_requests from BoundedV1 defaults to 16000000. v33 adds no resource ceiling change over v32. reads, dependency_requests, source_bytes, raw_bytes, models, per-file/parser/memory ceilings, disk/spool, inventory, stage, model, package and list-profile limits remain unchanged; this is not DiskWorldV1 and is never implicit.
source_policy.request_calls: RequestHeavyV1 raises only max_requests. Requests may retain model handles, so unchanged collector and startup memory limits remain enforced; any over-limit or memory failure remains fatal with no accepted prefix.
source_policy.db2_map: Publish exactly canonical Map FDID 1349477 through the disabled-key build-70450 available-source route with structural, exact partial-extent and zero-fill checks.
source_policy.partial_sections: Use per-table declared-skip rules for Map. Declarations remain per table; no decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.vmap_map_projection: Read sealed Map with read_vmap_maps_70450 and materialize its VMap projection. Re-derive sections and direct/copy/materialized facts. WDT==0 rows participate in graph/materialization but not active_maps or ROOT omission lists.
source_policy.domain: Build Maps::from_materialized_selection over the complete graph with MapSelection::All. Coverage contains every active map and never adds IDs hidden by omitted Map sections.
source_policy.wdt_root_absence: Only WDT MissingFile followed by guarded raw-ROOT zero-row proof may produce RootAbsent. WDT==0, omitted Map rows, ineligible ROOT, central/encoding absence and corruption are not such proof.
source_policy.model_root_absence: Only a WMO doodad M2 requested by FileDataId while converting a present WMO, with guarded root_has_no_rows(id) before child acquisition, may be declared. Each child increments dependency_requests, not top-level request_calls; it has zero child model_reads. Direct ADT M2 and logical-name requests are never eligible.
source_policy.vacated_wmo: Declare only a WMO FileDataId whose own conversion observed at least one locally declared ROOT-absent M2 doodad; output is None, bindings are empty, MODR participated in selection and selection.references is empty after omission. An originally empty WMO, an unused dependency, absent MODR participation, remaining geometry/binding, logical origin, unrelated failure or no local omission remains collision_no_valid_collision/fatal.
fatal_not_model_or_wmo_absence: direct ADT M2 Target::FileDataId even when raw ROOT has zero rows
M2 Target::Name or any logical-name request
WMO root or WMO group absence or malformed data
M2 with ROOT present but ineligible, central CKey absent, encoding absent or corrupt
WMO originally empty or dependency not used in MODR selection
conversion/no-collision without the complete vacated-WMO predicate
invalid associations, input guard changes and resource-limit failures
source_policy.omitted_model_effects: An omitted WMO doodad has zero child model_reads and no model handle, VMO, NameBinding, valid name or spawn. A present parent WMO and each present doodad remain, and missing_m2 is ordered, unique and bounded by the existing model ceiling.
source_policy.root_absent_map_effects: Skip WDT parser, globals, processing, placements, model requests, IDs, cache and callbacks for WDT ROOT-absent maps while retaining their active graph/coverage entries.
source_policy.present_effects: Present maps retain strict acquisition. Present empty maps have tree and empty proof; populated maps retain exact artifacts for every present WMO and doodad placement. report.maps includes all active maps and report.wdt_files counts present WDT inputs.
source_policy.parent_replay: If the immediate parent is WDT ROOT-absent, do not publish or verify parent-only inheritance and do not skip to a populated grandparent. A child with its own WDT continues without inheritance.
source_policy.root_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently reproduce raw ROOT absence for WDT inputs.
source_policy.model_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently prove WMO-doodad M2 ROOT absence or reconstruct original omitted requests and spawns.
source_policy.wmo_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently prove that a WMO was vacated by a local absent-M2 omission.
source_policy.source_authentication_flags: CKey/EKey acquisition facts are producer-reported, not independent cryptographic source authentication.
source_policy.gameobjects: GODI and global GameObject startup are excluded by profile policy. No GameObjectDisplayInfo request or GameObjectModels.dtree output is admitted.
source_policy.liquids: LiquidMaterial and LiquidType retain complete strict checks. LiquidObject is out of scope and is not requested.
source_policy.failure_policy: Only guarded WDT ROOT absence, WMO-doodad M2 ROOT absence and the exact vacated-WMO predicate are declarable. Every unrelated source, graph, placement, model, association, conversion or limit failure remains fatal.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, per-table Map declarations, independently re-derived Map sections and graph, present-map artifacts and associations, exact present-model inventory, declared WDT/M2/WMO omission boundaries and RequestHeavyV1 identity
verification.verify_links_scope: same v33 profile checks; no terrain, navigation, MMap or external package links
independently_derived_facts: Map section availability/admission and per-table partial declarations
VMap declared/direct/copy/materialized facts and ordered identities
complete materialized graph, active IDs, parents, depths, WDT FDIDs and MapEntry::is_parent
maps=wdt_files+root_absent and absence of artifacts for WDT-omitted maps
exact used_models/VMO inventory and absence of omitted M2/vacated WMO names, bindings, valid names, spawns and placements
RCVGEO1 v6 identity, package context and strict v33 plan binding
producer_reported_facts: raw ROOT absence for each declared WDT FDID
raw ROOT absence and original doodad request/spawn filtering for each missing_m2 FDID
zero child model_reads for declared doodads
WMO vacating policy result and local M2 ROOT omission for each missing_wmo FDID
verification.offline_limit: Offline verification cannot prove raw ROOT absences, WMO producer-side vacating decisions, or reconstruct original omitted child requests/spawns. It checks canonical declarations and all package-visible artifact boundaries; source absences remain producer-reported.
verification.missing_wmo_canonical: ordered, unique, nonzero, bounded and disjoint from missing_m2
